cskh.subtitle: Manage Zalo customers and bot knowledge.
cskh.facts_view: See the facts learned from this document
cskh.teach_hint: Type something the bot should know or correct, e.g. “The Basic plan is 950,000 VND/year from 1 Nov”. Paste a link and the bot reads that page. Each note is a document in the Documents table below, learned at once; Revoke then Delete to drop it.
cskh.teach_done: Received; the bot is learning it.
cskh.related_found: Received; the bot is learning it. Older facts on the subject are listed below.
cskh.related_title: {n} learned facts share this subject. If this note replaces old ones, pick the facts to retire:
cskh.ask_hint: Ask as a customer would to see how the bot answers from the knowledge. Unlike a test customer: escalation does not work here, no Telegram alert, no customer record.
cskh.groups_note: Groups the bot was added to. It stays silent until you allow a group; revoking silences it at once, though it stays in the group — leaving is done on the phone. In a group the bot does not hand off; it asks the customer to message privately.
cskh.mode_ambient: Without a mention, the bot decides
cskh.group_rename_hint: A name to recognise this group by (Zalo does not send group names)
cskh.unanswered: Questions the bot could not answer
cskh.unanswered_note: Customer questions the bot could not answer from its knowledge. “Teach the bot” puts the question in the Teach box; write the answer and send it, and the row is marked handled.
cskh.question: Question
cskh.ua_out_of_scope: Out of scope, handed to staff
cskh.ua_bot_no_info: The bot said it has no information
cskh.delivery_note: “Sent to queue” means published to the bus, not confirmed delivery by Telegram.
cskh.queued: Learning queued. Facts appear after extraction and validation.
cskh.confirm_block: Block this customer? The bot will ignore new messages.
cskh.confirm_revoke: Revoke this document? The bot will stop using it from the next turn; its facts will move to trash. Wait for any learning jobs to finish first.
cskh.confirm_delete: Delete this document from the KB catalog?
cskh.confirm_persona: SOUL.md already exists. Replace the current persona with the customer service template?
cskh.kb_note: MD, TXT, DOCX, PDF up to 4 MB. Scanned PDFs need OCR first. Publishing uses AI; enable learning and migration in Brain Graph. Review facts before serving customers.
cskh.settings_note: Channel settings apply to new messages. Restart the gateway after changing handoff text or pause duration to update the bot tool.
cskh.login_required: Please sign in to the dashboard again.
cskh.cleanup_pending: Document access revoked. Fact cleanup is pending; click Revoke to retry cleanup.
cskh.mode.title: Customer service mode
cskh.mode.description: This bot will answer Zalo customers allowed by the channel settings using published knowledge, with a restricted tool role. Use a separate bot for customer service.
cskh.mode.chat_id: Admin Telegram chat ID for handoffs
cskh.mode.acknowledge: I understand this bot will answer unfamiliar customers.
cskh.mode.state_10: Saved, not running yet. Restart to apply.
cskh.mode.state_01: Disabled in settings; the bot remains in customer service mode until restart.
cskh.mode.persona_install: The default persona will be replaced by the customer service persona.
cskh.mode.persona_already: The customer service persona is already installed.
cskh.mode.persona_keep: Your custom persona will be kept.
cskh.mode.blocker_telegram: Enable Telegram and enter its token on the Configuration page first.
cskh.mode.blocker_zalo: Enable Zalo on the Configuration page first.
cskh.mode.blocker_chat_id: Telegram chat ID must be an integer, e.g. 123456789 or -100123456789.
cskh.mode.warning_sessions: This workspace already contains chat sessions. It appears to be in use; customer service should use a separate bot.
cskh.mode.warning_host: The dashboard host is not loopback. Check firewall/network access so customers cannot reach the admin dashboard.
cskh.mode.warning_soul: SOUL.md has been customized and will not be overwritten. Use “Use customer service persona” on the customer service page if needed.
cskh.mode.undo_customers: This bot already has customers and cannot return to internal mode from the dashboard. Use Pause all on the customer service page or stop the bot.
cskh.mode.undo_state_error: Customer state could not be read safely. Undo is blocked; check the state file before trying again.
cskh.mode.undo_no_record: No activation record: only the two mode flags were turned off; other settings remain unchanged.
cskh.mode.undo_confirm: Restore the policy settings recorded before activation. This is allowed only before any customer has been recorded. Restart is required. An unchanged customer service persona will return to the default persona.
cskh.mode.login_again: Please sign in again and reload this page.
cskh.mode.error: The operation failed. Reload the page to check saved status.
cskh.mode.undo_record_error: Undo record is invalid or belongs to another workspace. Undo is blocked.
cskh.learning_pending: Knowledge learning jobs still queued or running: {n}
cskh.waiting_until: Waiting for staff · until {time} ({m} min left)
cskh.no_tabs: Press “View conversation” in the customer list, or create a test customer, to open a conversation here.
cskh.staff_reply: Reply to the customer as staff
cskh.staff_reply_hint: Sent from the bot's Zalo account. The bot stays quiet with this customer until you press Resume or the wait ends. Enter sends, Ctrl+Enter starts a new line.
cskh.staff_sent: Sent to the customer. Press Resume to hand back to the bot.
cskh.test_note: Each “New test customer” is a new customer. Messages take the same path as a real Zalo customer's: limits, pause, block, handoff. The bot's replies show here only and are not sent through Zalo. A handoff still notifies Telegram, marked [THỬ]. Test customers are not counted in Today.
cskh.confirm_test_clear: Remove every test customer and their conversations?
cskh.test_paused_note: the bot will not answer until the wait ends or you press Resume
graph.kb_quota_exempt: This daily limit does not apply to knowledge published from the customer service page in Public Customer Mode.
